---

## Interactive Plotly 3D Particle Energy Map

```{r plotly-chart, echo=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
set.seed(42)
n <- 350
theta <- runif(n, 0, 2 * pi)
r <- runif(n, 0.5, 5)
x <- r * cos(theta) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.1)
y <- r * sin(theta) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.1)
z <- (r^1.2) * sin(theta * 2) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.2)
energy <- sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2)

plot_ly(
  x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
  color = ~energy,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.85)
) %>%
layout(
  title = "3D Galactic Particle Energy Distribution",
  scene = list(
    xaxis = list(title = "Spatial X (kpc)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Spatial Y (kpc)"),
    zaxis = list(title = "Spatial Z (kpc)")
  )
)
```

---

## Key Presentation Highlights

- **Dynamic Interactivity:** Orbit, pan, and zoom in 3D space directly within the browser presentation.
- **Continuous Color Mapping:** Visualizes energy intensity dynamically mapped across 3D coordinates.
- **R Markdown Powered:** Built seamlessly with `rmarkdown` and `plotly` htmlwidgets.
